mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, activity_date = #{activityDate}, share_diet = #{shareDiet}, share_streak = #{shareStreak}, share_workout = #{shareWorkout}, diet_note = #{dietNote}, workout_note = #{workoutNote} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
